note: THE DEGENERATE SUBJECT, where all four spellings have to agree with each other. Emacs answers (0 0 0 0): an empty string has a start and an end at the same offset and every anchor matches there. kg answered (nil nil nil 0) before 26.2 -- the `^$' element was the control that showed kg's own anchors already handled the empty subject, so the three nils were the missing spellings and nothing else; kg answers (0 0 0 0) now. Worth freezing separately because an implementation that special-cases `end of subject' as `after the last character' has no last character here.
